mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , '' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM UZM0UI ta WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ymd = F_UZM0UI_YMD(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT ia.corp_gr AS corpGr , ia.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , '결산' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(ia.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(gi.gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , ia.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(gi.gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SKT0GS gi , SZM0IA ia WHERE gi.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND gi.gyul_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND F_OPEN_YMD(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), '+1') - 1 AND ia.corp_gr = gi.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = gi.fund_cd AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY secCd ASC, fundNm ASC, fundCd ASC, workGb ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM UZM0UI t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} ORDER BY ymd DESC

SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , '' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd}

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ( SELECT tt.fund_cd FROM (SELECT t1.FUND_CD , SUM(t1.SIGA_AEK) AS NAV , 0 AS SUN_JASAN_AEK FROM UZM0UI t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY t1.fund_cd UNION ALL SELECT t1.fund_cd , 0 , t1.sun_jasan_aek FROM SKT0GI t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.work_gb = 'A' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) tt GROUP BY tt.fund_cd HAVING NVL(SUM(tt.NAV), 0) <> NVL(SUM(tt.SUN_JASAN_AEK), 0) ) diff_list

SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(t1.dt), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS RUN_DT , MAX(u1.USER_NM) AS USER_NM FROM GIJUN_GA_COM t1 , FW_USER_MST u1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.dt = (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM GIJUN_GA_COM WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) AND u1.CORP_GR IN ('2200', t1.CORP_GR) AND u1.enc_e_mail = TO_ENCRYPTS(t1.userid)

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(sun_jasan_siga_aek), 0)) FROM UZM0UI t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
AND t1.type_gb NOT IN ('5', 'X')
AND t1.type_gb NOT IN ('5', '6', 'X')
